Container.Name: Kept
Container.Overview:
Kept is a self-hosted inventory of everything a household owns and where it is: places, boxes and things, with photos, receipts, warranties, vehicles, reminders, printed QR labels, an assistant and an MCP server.
One container: Kept and its own PostgreSQL database. Everything it keeps is in the appdata folder. Set Kept's address, start it, then read the setup code in the container's log.
Guide: https://keptinventory.info/install/unraid/
Container.Requires: 1 GB of free memory. The address you will open Kept at, such as http://tower.local:8080.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Kept is served on. If you change it, change Kept's address to match.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything Kept keeps: the database, photos and files, its keys, and the dump written on every stop (backup/kept.pgdump).

Config.Name: Kept's address
Config.Description: The address you open Kept at, such as http://tower.local:8080 or https://kept.example.com. No path. Printed labels, links in mail and sign-in use it, so use a name rather than an IP address.

Config.Name: Outgoing mail
Config.Description: Optional. An smtp:// or smtps:// URL, with the login if needed, such as smtps://user:password@mail.example.com:465. Empty: mail is only logged.

Config.Name: Mail sender
Config.Description: Optional. The From of every mail, such as Kept <kept@example.com>. Empty: no-reply at Kept's address.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxies
Config.Description: Optional. The address of your reverse proxy as Kept sees it, such as 192.0.2.10, or comma-separated addresses and ranges. Empty: no proxy is believed.

Config.Name: Extra addresses
Config.Description: Optional. Other addresses Kept answers on, comma-separated, each http(s)://host[:port] with the same scheme as Kept's address.

Config.Name: Sign-in length over http (days)
Config.Description: Optional. 1 to 30: how many days a sign-in lasts over plain http, renewed as it is used. Empty: 12 hours. No effect over https.

Config.Name: HSTS
Config.Description: Optional. off when other services on the same host name are on plain http. Empty: on (sent over https only).

Config.Name: Sign-up
Config.Description: Optional. true or false locks sign-up open or closed. Empty: an admin decides in Kept.

Config.Name: Upload limit (MB)
Config.Description: Optional. 1 to 2048. Empty: 25.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Optional. Sign-in with your identity provider: the issuer URL exactly as its discovery document states it. Redirect URL to register: Kept's address followed by /api/v1/auth/callback/oidc.

Config.Name: OIDC client id
Config.Description: Optional. The client id, with the issuer.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Optional. The client secret, for a confidential client.

Config.Name: OIDC name
Config.Description: Optional. The provider's name on the sign-in button. Empty: OIDC.

Config.Name: OIDC account domains
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated email domains whose people get an account on their first sign-in. Empty: invite only.

Config.Name: OIDC account groups
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated groups whose members get an account on their first sign-in. Empty: invite only.

Config.Name: OIDC groups claim
Config.Description: Optional. The ID token claim holding the groups. Empty: groups.

Config.Name: OIDC scopes
Config.Description: Optional. Space-separated. Empty: openid email profile.

Config.Name: Google client id
Config.Description: Optional. Sign-in with Google: the OAuth client id. Google needs Kept's address on https with a public domain name. Redirect URL: Kept's address followed by /api/v1/auth/callback/google.

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: Optional. The OAuth client secret, with the client id.

Config.Name: Apprise server
Config.Description: Optional. The Apprise API server for Apprise notification channels, such as http://apprise:8000. Empty: none.

Config.Name: Metrics token
Config.Description: Optional. The bearer token that turns /metrics on. Empty: no /metrics.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error.
